A '''Static Discharge Dish''' was a large component that topped the [[220-SIG Tactical Combat Jammer]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The directional dish generated jamming signals along specific vectors. This created narrow zones of interference that allowed the majority of an installation's [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] clear to gather information.<ref name="EGWT" />
